def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1)
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep+1:] for row in grid]
    width = min(len(left[0]), len(right[0]))
    bg_left, bg_right = left[0][0], right[0][0]
    return [[3 if left[r][c] == bg_left and right[r][c] == bg_right else bg_right for c in range(width)] for r in range(h)]
